SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_key, m.route_id, m.menu_name AS label, m.order_num, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.is_frame, m.path, m.icon FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE rm.menu_id = m.menu_id AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' )
ORDER BY m.order_num, m.menu_key, m.menu_id
SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY r.role_sort, r.role_id
